posts.author: EbonSkolli
posts.body:
Here's a new plugin I finished the other day! This one makes it easier to setup hotkeys for menus/custom scenes, including the use of the escape key. Pressing the hotkeys defined in this plugin will open and close the scene they are set to trigger.
Note that the escape key will no longer trigger menu/cancel with this plugin. You can still set it up in a way that it triggers the menu with "escape:Scene_Menu".
HOW TO USE:
To add custom hotkeys, use the format "key:SceneName" separated by commas.
Example: "I:Scene_Item,S:Scene_Skill,escape:Scene_GameEnd,F:Scene_Example"
TERMS OF USE:
Use for commercial or non-commercial projects. Please credit EbonSkolli if you use this plugin.
